messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] nightly-rollout started for service inference-gateway tag=v2026.03.15
sarah: seeing canary 1 502s, piling up
mike: paging oncall (inc oncall-sre)
incident-bot: Pager: oncall-sre triggered — error-rate spike >10% on inference-gateway (canary). Incident: https://incidents/redwood/3456001234
jordan: I'm on it, checking canary logs now
sarah: metrics show 502s correlate with image pull errors: "failed to resolve image digest: manifest has no matching manifest for linux/amd64"
lee: that smells like registry retag or mirror returned different digest. any CI retag steps today? @mike
mike: CI ran a force-retag in pipeline ci/5678 this morning to attach stable tag, yes
jordan: listing registry images
jordan: ```
# gcloud artifacts docker images list us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/redwood-prod/inference-gateway
v2026.03.15
v2026.03.15-retag
```
sarah: canary nodes pulling v2026.03.15 but registry returns older digest -> cache/mirror inconsistency (cache poisoning feel)
mike: customer impact estimate?
sarah: currently scoped to canary route; traffic spillover shows ~0.5% of prod requests affected, error budget small but some customers hit 502s
lee: recommend immediate kill-switch: disable canary routing flag to stop spillover
jordan: executing flag toggle now
jordan: `curl -s -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://flags.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"key":"routing.canary.enabled","value":false}'` -> 200 OK
deploy-bot: Canary routing disabled by jordan :white_check_mark:
sarah: watching error rate — dropping already
mike: also pause CI retag flow and block further retags for this pipeline
ci-bot: Pausing retag step on job ci/5678 — acknowledged
jordan: draining canary pods to clear bad images
jordan: `kubectl drain -l canary=inference-gateway --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
sarah: drain started, new pods scheduled on stable pool (no canary)
registry-bot: Mirror flush requested for repo inference-gateway (ticket REG-9123) — eu-west1 mirror showing stale digest
lee: confirmed: origin has digest sha256:AAA, eu-west1 mirror returned sha256:BBB for same tag
mike: ok — short-term mitigation done. product-ops, want a quick customer note? minimal impact but visible
product-ops: will draft a short status: "Partial errors for small subset of requests during nightly rollout; mitigation applied; rollback/rollback prevented; monitoring continues." Want timestamps and next steps
sarah: status -> healthy after 3m, error-rate back to baseline for affected routes
jordan: follow-up items: 1) block retag workflows until we enforce digest pinning 2) add CI check to verify mirror digests match origin post-retag 3) add registry propagation monitoring
mike: adding to runbook and opening postmortem ticket PM-345600 — include timeline + commands used
sarah: saving logs and traces now, will attach to ticket
jordan: closing pager, will hand to oncall follow-up for postmortem
incident-bot: Pager resolved by jordan. Duration: 13m. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents/redwood/3456001234/summary
